Chinese law: Article 240 of Criminal Law: kidnapping (绑架) of persons, punishable. Also Article 260: kidnapping of minors for adoption? Actually "拐骗儿童" is separate: "拐骗儿童罪" (Article 260). The facts: He abducted a child, intending to keep as his own. That's kidnapping (绑架). So answer: [罪名]绑架<eoa>.

Thus final answer: [罪名]绑架<eoa>.
